input.jobDescription:
VP of Engineering at ScaleUp Inc

ScaleUp Inc is a Series C SaaS company with $80M ARR, growing 3x year-over-year. We are searching for a VP of Engineering to lead our 80-person engineering organization.

Responsibilities:
- Define engineering vision and multi-year technology roadmap
- Build and scale engineering teams across 4 product areas
- Drive engineering culture: quality, velocity, and psychological safety
- Own engineering P&L (~$15M annual budget)
- Partner with CTO, CPO, and CEO on company strategy
- Lead M&A technical due diligence as needed

Requirements:
- 10+ years of software engineering experience, 5+ in engineering leadership
- Proven track record scaling engineering orgs from 20 to 100+ engineers
- Experience running distributed teams across multiple time zones
- Strong technical depth — must earn respect of IC engineers
- Background in B2B SaaS product development

This is a senior executive role reporting directly to the CTO. Compensation includes base salary, bonus, and significant equity.

Apply at scaleup.io/leadership-roles
